headline: CISA confirms GitLab RCE and Cisco ASA/FTD as exploited (due Nov 1); Volt Typhoon hits Cisco SD-WAN; Binance breach put at $6.3B

bullets.text: New: CISA added actively exploited GitLab CE/EE RCE CVE-2026-97229 (CVSS 10.0) and Cisco ASA/FTD VPN DoS CVE-2026-76418 to KEV, both with a federal due date of 2026-11-01. An attacker already tried the GitLab flaw against Alpine Linux's instance.
Attackers are exploiting Cisco SD-WAN flaw CVE-2026-20127 to deploy custom KeyDrift malware; the activity is tied to Volt Typhoon's 'Silent Train' network, used in four zero-day campaigns.

China-linked attackers used VMware ESX zero-day CVE-2026-41709 to reduce audit trail visibility; PHP2Shell and Fragnesia were chained to root firewalls, and The Record reports limited successful PHP2Shell exploitation.

Exploitation attempts have begun against Oracle E-Business Suite RCE CVE-2026-101767, days after Oracle patched it. Attackers also turned GitHub issues into a supply-chain campaign against 61 public repos in under an hour.

The Binance breach is now put at $6.3 billion in affected assets, with nearly $3 billion frozen and withdrawals paused. Polymarket halted trading after a crypto-draining script breach with $2.5M traced.

Breaches: iRhythm toll put at 8.2 million; Florida's education department says 4.9 million may be affected; hacktivists leaked records on 41,000 DHS staff; Belgium's tax agency pulled services offline after a cyberattack; UNM Health is restoring systems.

actions: Patch self-managed GitLab CE/EE for CVE-2026-97229 before 2026-11-01 and check GitLab logs for exploitation attempts.
Apply Cisco's fix for ASA/FTD VPN CVE-2026-76418 before 2026-11-01 and review VPN logs and device crashes.
Patch Cisco SD-WAN for CVE-2026-20127 per Cisco's advisory and hunt for KeyDrift malware on SD-WAN components.
Apply your distro's kernel fix for CVE-2026-46300 before 2026-10-31; finish PHP updates for CVE-2026-109618/109619 (KEV due date passed).
Patch VMware ESX CVE-2026-41709 (KEV due 2026-11-11) and confirm Oracle's fix for EBS CVE-2026-101767 is applied.
If you hold funds on Binance or Polymarket, follow their official status channels and ignore unsolicited 'recovery' offers.
